verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file returns HTTP 200 at help.getzep.com/llms.txt with a structured Zep Documentation index, and a versioned /v3/llms.txt also exists. The docs pages are served as raw .md URLs, which makes them agent-readable. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs, and no independent community corroboration of agents consuming them.
